title: Repeat Recollection Offers on One Accession — Laboratory Test Orders
content:
A Laboratory Test Orders accession may receive a second recollection offer after a further rejection. The causes of the earlier rejections decide the day from which the recollection window is counted, that is, whether the patient's recollection clock restarts.

## The rule

1. **First offer.** A first recollection offer on the accession (no earlier recollection request on it) counts the recollection window from the rejection date.
2. **Earlier request, every earlier rejection collection-related.** The accession already carries an earlier recollection request, and every rejection on it other than the most recent had a collection-related cause (*hemolyzed*, *quantity not sufficient*, *unlabeled or mislabeled* or *wrong container*). The patient's recollection clock is not restarted. The recollection window is counted from the date of the latest earlier recollection request instead of from the rejection date. The recollect-by date this gives is never earlier than **1 day** after the rejection date.
3. **Earlier request, an earlier rejection transport-related.** The accession already carries an earlier recollection request, and at least one rejection on it other than the most recent had a transport-related cause (*stability exceeded* or *leaked in transit*). The recollection clock restarts on the day this recollection is offered. The recollection window is counted from today instead of from the rejection date.

The cause of the most recent rejection does not decide between cases 2 and 3; only the rejections before it do.

## Worked cases (hypothetical recollection window of 14 days)

| Case | Earlier request dated | Rejections before the most recent | Most recent rejection dated | Offered on | Window counted from | Recollect-by date | Calendar days from the rejection date to the recollect-by date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | none | none | 9 May | 9 May | 9 May (rejection date) | 23 May | 14 |
| B | 2 May | hemolyzed | 9 May | 9 May | 2 May (earlier request) | 16 May | 7 |
| C | 1 May | wrong container | 20 May | 20 May | 1 May (earlier request) | 21 May | 1 |
| D | 2 May | leaked in transit | 9 May | 12 May | 12 May (day of the offer) | 26 May | 17 |

In case C, counting 14 days from 1 May would reach 15 May, which is earlier than 1 day after the rejection. The recollect-by date is therefore 21 May, 1 day after the rejection date.
